claims.claim: Bryce Lynch distinguishes detail, which he calls trivia, from specificity, and says detail is bad.
claims.source: Bryce Lynch, review of 'The Swan Hollow Intrigue', tenfootpole.org, 2026
claims.quote: In this context detail is bad. It is trivia.

claims.claim: Justin Alexander warns a writer adapting a home campaign against trying to recapture the campaign instead of the scenario.

claims.quote: trying to recapture the campaign instead of the scenario

claims.claim: David Hartlage says an expanded room description pads a good middle sentence like a school paper stretched to length.
